brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit with a drawer
requirements.evidence: Half base piece:0,1,0 (half-s) carries drawer drawer:0#0,1#cut (style n, cut face), on a small cluster of full bases piece:0,0,0, piece:1,0,0, piece:1,-1,0 and half-w piece:-1,0,0. Mesh check clear.

requirements.requirement: Spike at a corner where three bases meet
requirements.evidence: spike:0#0,0|1,-1|1,0 (mount type) stands at the junction of bases (0,0), (1,-1) and (1,0).

requirements.requirement: Small platform held by the spike
requirements.evidence: setSpikeAccessory with platform-sm on the mount spike returned ok with no errors, but the platform does not appear as its own node in get_build, so I could not independently confirm it is attached. A mount spike was required; the earlier solid spike refused the platform (TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED).
check_build: meshClash clear, LOOSE_BODY warning cleared by joint bolts jointBolt:0#0,0#0 and jointBolt:0#1,0#2; only info-level OPEN_CAP_FACE remains. Not a strength rating.

finish.summary: Built a compact desk unit: a small cluster of bases with a half base carrying a drawer, plus a mount-type spike at the corner where three bases meet, with a small platform set on the spike. The build passes the mesh check with no rule errors. The one uncertainty is the platform, which returned success but is not listed as a separate part, so its attachment is unverified. This checks fit only, not load.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
